text: I had a similar experience. I went to get dentures fitted, and the work wasn't done properly. As soon as I found out it needed fixing, the dentist became rude and disrespectful, implying I was being difficult. I usually go there often and never have problems, but this time I saw their true colors. I was stunned and so angry I couldn't speak or argue. Even on the second visit, they continued to be disrespectful. I decided that if the work wasn't satisfactory, I would just pay and go somewhere else. I tried to control my emotions and avoid arguing, just to get it over with and never go back again. It was truly infuriating.
Terrible. Rude and disrespectful. Why don't they just put up a sign saying "We don't do this service if you smoke?"
